learning_objective: 🎯 Become a choreographer and invent your own magical dance steps by mixing jumps, twirls, and claps!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A choreographer is like an author, but instead of writing words, they invent and arrange the fun dance steps!
A sequence is a pattern of moves. You can create one by joining a spin, a jump, and a clap together in a special order.
A good dancer uses all the space around them! You can dance high on your toes, low to the ground, or moving across the room.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The 1-2-3 Magic Dance!
fun_activity.instructions: Pick three simple moves, like a jump, a wiggle, and a spin. Practice doing them in order, over and over, to create your very first choreography!

quick_recap: ⭐ Choreographers are artists who design and invent dance routines.
⭐ A dance sequence is a connected pattern of fun movements.
⭐ We can make dances more exciting by moving high, low, and all around the room.
